summary: Iteration 21: validated Excel margin/theme refactor (pretty_excel + weekly_attendance_excel now start content at B2, with col A and row 1 as spacers) and three frontend changes (public /profil-sekolah page, Login school-info card moved to top with 'Lihat Profil Sekolah' link, 17-slide Presentation deck with 'MASALAH YANG KAMI JAWAB' banners). 7/7 backend tests passed (0 skipped after fix). All 10 frontend UI assertions passed. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: The old iteration_20 regression test (test_iter20_weekly_attendance.py) still asserts `ws['A1']` contains 'LAGUBOTI' and `test_inventory_export_neat` / `test_social_fund_export_neat` do the same — after the B2 refactor these three asserts will FAIL on next run. Main agent should update that file (change `ws['A1']` -> `ws['B2']`) or delete the superseded assertions. The newer file /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_excel_margins.py already covers the margin layout correctly.
server.py is now ~4028 lines — strongly consider splitting (attendance, inventory, exports, auth, library...) into routers.
pretty_excel and weekly_attendance_excel duplicate a lot of margin/title boilerplate; worth extracting a `_write_margin_header(ws, title, subtitle, n_cols, CO=2)` helper to keep the two in sync.
weekly_attendance_excel: column widths are set with hard-coded indexes assuming CO=2; if CO ever changes this will silently misalign. Consider deriving indexes from CO.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter21 covers Excel margin/theme refactor and the three frontend changes. Backend assertions: _assert_margin_layout(ws) checks row 1 empty, col A empty, B2 contains brand, col A width <=4. Covered endpoints: /inventory/export, /social-fund/export, /users/export, /classes/{cid}/kas/export, /attendance/week/export, /attendance/export (regression), /presentation/pptx (regression). Frontend verified: /login -> school-info card at top (y=120, below name y=48) with 'Lihat Profil Sekolah' button; /profil-sekolah accessible unauthenticated with Tentang/Visi/Misi sections and Masuk button; /presentasi shows '1 / 17', 17 dots, slide-dot/next/prev navigation working, pptx download link and print button present, and 7/7 feature slides (indices 2,3,6,8,10,12,13) carry 'MASALAH YANG KAMI JAWAB' banner. NOTE: test_iter20_weekly_attendance.py has 3 stale asserts (`ws['A1']` -> should be `ws['B2']`) — see critical_code_review_comments.
